summary: Parses XML or SGML/HTML text into an internal element tree, filters scoped elements, and outputs selected element summaries, tree views, attributes, or text for further processing.

key_params.name: sgml
key_params.note: Parse input as SGML/HTML instead of strict XML

key_params.name: merge
key_params.note: Merge a second XML input before, after, inside, or replacing an element

key_params.name: oaname
key_params.note: Output only attributes whose name matches

key_params.name: oavalue
key_params.note: Output only attributes whose value matches

key_params.name: show
key_params.note: Choose output presentation such as summary table or summary tree

key_params.name: oclabel
key_params.note: Output only children whose labels match

key_params.name: lprefix
key_params.note: Control whether element labels are prefixed in table-style outputs

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when extension mode uses a custom extension

common_gotchas: XML DAT first builds an internal tree, then scope filters select elements for output.
Every parsed element gets labels such as n0, n1, with a reserved root element at level 0.
Tagged elements and text nodes are distinct element types, so filters must match the parsed type model.
The second input used for Merge must be XML formatted, not SGML/HTML.
Start broad with the default match-all scope, then narrow label/type/text/attribute filters iteratively.
key_concepts: XML DAT parses XML or SGML/HTML into an internal element tree before filtering output.
Element scope parameters filter labels, types, text, attributes, and parent element attributes.
Output parameters choose summary tables, summary trees, XML, attributes, children, or text output.
The second input can be merged into the first XML tree before, after, inside, or replacing a scoped element.
